name: Kinetic Tech Incident
summary: Editorial kinetic documentary: near-black stage, oversized Poppins display, one accent per act, evidence panels, restrained texture, dedicated 16:9 and 4:5 cover.

layout.grid: Left = statement, right = evidence in wide. Header kicker left, tags right. Footer rule with one mono line left and one right.

panels.statusChip: 14-15% accent tint with accent mono text

rules.secondAccent: Must be a tag or rule, never a headline.
rules.cyanAndGreen: Never place cyan and green body text side by side without a panel between them.

actMapping.hook: cyan -> red as the deletion lands

typography.fallback: SF Pro Display, SF Pro Text, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
typography.mono: SF Mono, SFMono-Regular, ui-monospace, Menlo, Courier New, monospace
typography.rule: Never use more than three type sizes in one scene.

motion.headline: Rises inside a clipping mask, 0.7s, easeOut.
motion.impact: Fast red rule or GlitchText, 0.35-0.55s, easeIn.
motion.sweep: One soft Beam on the act's biggest beat, never on every cut.
motion.brandClose: Spring settle only; no loop, no shimmer.
rules: No bounce, no elastic, no rotation on type.
Every scene ends on a held frame; motion stops before the cut.
Cut the picture before the narration sentence so the visual lands first.

narrativeSpine.job: State the impossible fact, then the contradiction.
Show the normal work that made the incident possible.
Show the control that was supposed to hold.
Execute the destructive beat in red.
Correct the record; relief, not triumph.
Name the architectural principle, not the moral.
One sentence of hope, one sentence of warning, then the question.

wideRules: Same script, same score, same act boundaries, new layout.
Recompose for 16:9 with split columns, wider panels and more negative space.
Never crop, stretch or letterbox the vertical.
Footer text is factual: source or reconstruction note, never a slogan.
coverRules: Same palette and type system as the film.
One oversized headline stack, one evidence object, one quiet detail.
Use a static composition with durationInFrames=1.
Cover type may be larger than any in-film type; that is the one place to exaggerate.
copyRules: Report only what sources reported. Use 'reportedly' where the claim is contested.
Never invent a database engine, SQL statement, agent reasoning, permanent data loss or financial loss.
Label reconstructions: ILLUSTRATIVE RECONSTRUCTION - NOT A VERIFIED SCREENSHOT.
Numbers on screen must match the narration.
Headlines in the present tense; body copy in plain language.

rules: No SFX on every cut; one impact per act maximum.

qa: Targeted npx eslint on new scene files passes.
npx remotion compositions lists the vertical, wide and cover IDs.
Preview stills in Studio at every act beat; no text collision, no clipped descenders.
Headline is the first thing the eye finds.
Accent count per frame is 2 or fewer.
Caption band is clear; footer does not overlap panels.
Brand close is avatar + bold SIMPLEDEAV only.
No MP4 export. Browser preview and stills are the sign-off.
